lines.text: Many learners say: My hobby is read books.
Better: My hobby is reading books.
After my hobby is, use reading.
Reading! My hobby is reading books.

data.why: After my hobby is, use reading.

native.tip: Kita bilang “hobi saya membaca buku” tanpa mengubah kata kerja. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah My hobby is pakai bentuk -ing.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “My hobby is read books.” 😅 Setelah My hobby is, pakai -ing: “My hobby is reading books.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “reading”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “My hobby is reading books.” lalu tulis hobimu dengan -ing. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “hobi saya membaca buku” and the verb does not change. In English, after My hobby is use the -ing form.
en.caption: Ever say this? “My hobby is read books.” 😅 After My hobby is, use -ing: “My hobby is reading books.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
